Background / Context

FreeScout is an open-source help desk and shared inbox solution, designed as a lightweight alternative to commercial customer support applications like Zendesk and Help Scout. Built using the Laravel PHP framework, FreeScout offers flexibility through an extensive module system, allowing customization of its features. It enables organizations to manage customer support independently, without privacy concerns or dependency on third-party services.

 Objectives

The primary objective is to provide a cost-effective, self-hosted help desk solution that is customizable and fully-featured, ensuring users maintain control over their data.

 Stakeholders & Users

- Support Agents: Manage customer interactions, respond to queries, and track conversation statuses.
- Administrators: Customize and configure the platform, manage users, and oversee overall system operations.
- Customers: Communicate with support agents via email or integrated platforms like Slack or WhatsApp.

 Functional Descriptions

- Agent Management: Support for unlimited agents and mailboxes.
- Communication: Starred conversations, seamless email integration, auto-replies, internal notes, and conversation forwarding and merging.
- Notifications & Tracking: Push notifications, conversation following, collision detection, and open tracking.
- User Interaction Features: Multilingual support, keyboard shortcuts, mentions, and screen reader accessibility.
- Integration & Automation: Integrations with Slack, WhatsApp, Facebook, Telegram, LDAP, email commands, and Kanban boards.
- Conversation Management: Auto-refreshing conversation lists, saving replies, satisfaction ratings, spam filtering, and conversation tagging.
- Security & Privacy: Built with a strong focus on security and privacy.

 Non-Functional Descriptions

- Performance: Lightweight system design for efficient performance with minimal resource usage.
- Scalability: Ability to handle an unlimited number of tickets and customer interactions.
- Accessibility: Supports screen readers and provides a mobile-friendly interface.
- Usability: Easy web installer and integration of multiple communication channels for enhanced user experience.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0083
CREATE TABLE `agents` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `agents_email_unique` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `administrators` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `administrators_email_unique` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `customers_email_unique` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `conversations` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `customer_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `agent_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `conversation_status` enum('open','closed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `conversations_customer_id_foreign` (`customer_id`),
  KEY `conversations_agent_id_foreign` (`agent_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `conversations_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`agent_id`) REFERENCES `agents` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `conversation_logs` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `conversation_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `log_type` enum('email','slack','whatsapp','facebook','telegram','ldap','email_command','kanban_board') NOT NULL,
  `log_data` text,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `conversation_logs_conversation_id_foreign` (`conversation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_logs_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `conversations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `integrations` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `type` enum('slack','whatsapp','facebook','telegram','ldap','email_command','kanban_board') NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `conversation_integrations` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `conversation_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `integration_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `conversation_integrations_conversation_id_foreign` (`conversation_id`),
  KEY `conversation_integrations_integration_id_foreign` (`integration_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_integrations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `conversations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_integrations_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`integration_id`) REFERENCES `integrations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tags` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `conversation_tags` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `conversation_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `tag_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `conversation_tags_conversation_id_foreign` (`conversation_id`),
  KEY `conversation_tags_tag_id_foreign` (`tag_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_tags_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `conversations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `conversation_tags_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`tag_id`) REFERENCES `tags` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `satisfaction_ratings` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `conversation_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `rating` tinyint(1) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `satisfaction_ratings_conversation_id_foreign` (`conversation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `satisfaction_ratings_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `conversations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `spam_filters` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `conversation_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `filter_type` enum('email','slack','whatsapp','facebook','telegram','ldap','email_command','kanban_board') NOT NULL,
  `filter_data` text,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `spam_filters_conversation_id_foreign` (`conversation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `spam_filters_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `conversations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
